title: Notifications stopped going out
description: No password reset emails since 03:21. The notification worker keeps logging NoBrokersAvailable.

title: Checkout returning 502 after the afternoon release
description: About 9% of POST /checkout requests return 502 since v2.31.0 rolled out; pods are Ready.

title: Orders cannot be placed
description: Order writes time out after 30 seconds while browsing works; the app waits for a pool connection.

title: Search results stale, indexer pods restarting
description: New products take hours to appear; search-indexer pods restart with exit code 137.

title: Customers in Germany logged out after login
description: Users enter correct credentials and get Invalid session; only eu-central is affected.

title: Annual subscribers charged twice
description: Support reports duplicate renewal charges since last night's billing release.

title: Card payments failing for European customers
description: Charges hang and then fail for some customers. Alert and latency chart attached.

title: Internal tools rejecting requests
description: Calls to internal tools fail with x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid.

title: Dashboard footer shows last year
description: The customer dashboard footer says 2025 after today's release.

title: Office printers crash on PDFs
description: Shared office printers stop responding whenever someone prints a PDF from Edge.

title: Marketing site hero image blurry
description: The hero banner looks low resolution on recent iPhones.
